annotations.text:
PROPOSED — phone

One choice at the top that fills five fields. Then only what is required: site and title. Everything else folded, each closed row saying what is already in it.

A footer that never scrolls away: when the draft last saved, what is still missing, and Create.
The same form with every section opened, so the actual fields can be approved. On the phone these stay closed until you need one.
Option C, agreed. A JobDraft row per person, saved as you type, promoted to a Job on Create. The INT WO number is a preview until then, so an abandoned draft leaves no gap in the sequence.
Kept for the record: the measurement, the reproduced bug, and why C was chosen over A and B.
